image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a black computer keyboard. The image focuses on the bottom row, prominently featuring an elongated rectangular key (the space bar) flanked by two smaller modifier keys. Above these are rows of standard square/rectangular letter keys. The keys have a matte finish with white legends.
